name: Decision Tree / Regression Tree (CART)
when_to_use: Categorical (classification) or continuous (regression) dependent variable; tabular data, no normality/linearity requirement; overfitting controlled via pruning (cp) and train-test validation.

expected_input.question: How to predict with a decision-tree-based model?

plain_explanation.purpose: Generates a sequence of yes/no questions leading to a decision or prediction.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you need a rule that is easy to explain and draw.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table with the response (category or number) and factor columns.
plain_explanation.example: Decide whether a customer is at high risk of canceling, through simple questions about usage and tenure.
